{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend tailored trousers in charcoal gray (#3f4244), slim-straight cut at the ankle with a mid-weight fabric that resists snow dampness.  
Merino wool fitted turtleneck sweater in heather black (#1a1a1a), crewneck style with long sleeves and a slightly relaxed fit for comfort during walking.  
Leather-look trench coat in slate gray (#5c6b73), knee-length cut with a structured shoulder and front button closure to block wind and light snow.  
Chelsea boots in matte black leather, ankle-high cut with an elasticized side panel and a low 4cm heel for stable walking on salted streets.  
This outfit works because the charcoal and slate tones create a professional yet grounded look suitable for a business meeting in cold weather. The wool textures provide essential warmth against the -10°C temperature while remaining breathable enough for active movement. The structured silhouette of the trench coat and trousers conveys polish without sacrificing comfort during the 20-minute walk to the appointment."}
